input.subject: Tenant looking - studio/1BR Astoria under $3,000/mo
input.bodyText:
Hi everyone,

I have a reliable tenant relocating for a new job in LIC and open to Astoria.

- Studio or 1BR
- Up to $3,000/mo, ideally no fee
- Astoria (Ditmars/Steinway area fine), close to N/W
- Cats OK a big plus
- Move-in flexible, Aug-Sept
- Guarantor available (Insurent OK)

Anything available or coming up? Co-broke welcome.

Maya Osei
Douglas Elliman
